The Judgment was delivered by : Prafulla C. Pant, J.
1. This appeal is directed against judgment and order dated 1.5.2014, passed by the High Court of Judicature for Rajasthan, in D.B. Civil Special Appeal (W) No. 428 of 2014 whereby the Division Bench declined to interfere with the order passed by learned Single Judge.
2. We have heard learned counsel for the parties, and perused the record.
3. facts: One Kalyan Singh father of the respondent Revat Singh was a driver with appellant Rajasthan State Road Transport Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the 'Corporation').
The respondent sought compassionate appointment on the post of driver.
His educational qualification was 8th standard pass.

The appellants considered the application for appointment on compassionate ground, and rejected the same on the ground that the respondent was not qualified either for the post of driver or that of conductor.
issues: Whether the High Court erred in law in directing the appellant to consider the case of respondent for appointment against the post of driver on the compassionate ground.
Whether the respondent is qualified for the post of driver as he is neither matriculate nor possessed driving licence for heavy vehicles.
petitioner_arguments: The High Court has erred in law in directing the appellant to consider the case of respondent for appointment against the post of driver on the compassionate ground.
The respondent is not qualified for the post of driver as he is neither matriculate nor possessed driving licence for heavy vehicles.
respondent_arguments: The respondent be engaged at least against post of Artisan Grade II.
court_reasoning: This Court has held that compassionate appointment can not be granted to a post for which the candidate is ineligible.

Even though higher post was applied for on compassionate ground, when a lower post offered considering qualification and eligibility as per rules was accepted by the candidate, he cannot claim higher post.
The courts and tribunals do not have the power to issue direction to make appointment by way of granting relaxation of eligibility or in contravention thereof.
holding: The appeal is allowed. However, the respondent shall be allowed to work on the post of Artisan Grade III as offered to him.
